correctness.rationale: Finite acyclic path coefficients admit at most h-1 nontrivial path factors, yielding O(n^(h-1)q^(hn)) dimensions. Delta interpolation and diagonal commutator separators give at least q^(n-1)(q^(n-1)-1)^(h-1) independent polynomial functions. Both estimates hold for every finite F_q and all n>=2, giving the exact root limit. Edgeless h=1 is handled separately, with exact q^n dimension. A finite binary path algebra script verified six cases plus 36 separator supports; no infinite proof rests on experiments.
